propositions: The Anthropic cache breakpoint applies to the whole system block, so only byte-identical full system prompts share cache entries; Pass-1 and Pass-2 currently render through different paths with no shared plan-bearing prefix, preventing cache reuse across passes and within verifier chunks.

The finder and both verifier prompts must share a byte-identical leading prefix (single-sourced as prompts.shared_plan_prefix) containing the full plan text, enabling within-pass reuse for verifier chunks and cross-run reuse within Anthropic's ephemeral cache TTL (~5 min).

The Pass-1 exhaustiveness directive ('enumerate EVERY independent defect in THIS run; do not defer deeper findings to a later review round') must be moved into the shared preamble so it reaches every Pass-1 request and inert in verifier prefix.

The verifier templates must replace their {{plan}} variable and volatile marker with {{shared_prefix}} leading the body, moving the per-run finding listing to user-turn (base_instructions → instructions) and removing plan from the stable system prompt.

The Pass-1 warm gate must measure the actual cached prefix (shared_plan_prefix) rather than plan alone, so for boundary plans where est_tokens(plan) < CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS <= _prefix_tokens(plan) the warm condition holds.
